## Current role
- Title, company, what the company does, size: Operations Analyst, Northwind Freight, a regional less-than-truckload (LTL) freight carrier with 4 cross-dock terminals in the Midwest, about 300 employees. March 2021 to present.
- Reports to / works with: Reports to the Director of Operations. Works daily with the 4 terminal managers, dock supervisors, the carrier relations team, and finance. No direct reports.

## Day-to-day
- Monday: builds and sends the weekly operations report (volume, dock dwell time, on-time pickups, cost per shipment) to the Director of Operations and terminal managers.
- Daily: checks the dock scheduling dashboard for the Joliet and Gary terminals, flags late inbound appointments, answers ad hoc data requests from terminal managers.
- Weekly: carrier performance review with the carrier relations team using the carrier scorecard.
- Monthly: freight cost and accrual reconciliation with finance in NetSuite.
- Recurring: writes SQL against the warehouse and transportation databases, maintains Tableau dashboards, and runs process walk-throughs on the dock floor when a metric moves.
- Tools touched daily: SQL (SQL Server), Excel, Tableau, NetSuite.
